verdict.rationale: Brex is a hosted spend-management and financial platform. Asking whether its software can be deployed on-premises is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only hosted APIs, webhooks, integrations and a hosted MCP server, with no self-hosted, on-premises or open-source deployment option documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
